mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (activity_id, activity_name, activity_desc, begin_date_time, end_date_time, draw_config_id, take_count, state, creator, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{activityDesc}, #{beginDateTime}, #{endDateTime}, #{drawConfigId}, #{takeCount}, #{state}, #{creator}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT activity_id, activity_name, activity_desc, begin_date_time, end_date_time, draw_config_id, take_count, state, creator, create_time, update_time FROM activity WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT id, activity_id, draw_config_id, state, begin_date_time, end_date_time FROM activity WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE draw_config_id = #{drawConfigId} AND state IN (5, 7)

SELECT id, activity_id, activity_name, begin_date_time, end_date_time, state, creator FROM activity WHERE id > #{id} AND ((state = 4 AND begin_date_time <= NOW()) OR (state = 5 AND end_date_time <= NOW())) ORDER BY ID ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT activity_id, activity_name, activity_desc, begin_date_time, end_date_time, state FROM activity WHERE state = 5 AND begin_date_time <= NOW() AND end_date_time >= NOW() ORDER BY activity_id
